author: supergamer001
body:
Closes #6

This pull request introduces a comprehensive overhaul of the chat read receipt system, adding real-time, per-user read indicators and improving the accuracy and efficiency of read status tracking in both the frontend (`friends.js`) and backend (`server.js`). The changes implement live read receipt updates using WebSockets, UI enhancements to display which users have read up to which message, and robust mechanisms to ensure read status is saved reliably and only moves forward.

Key changes include:

**Frontend: Real-Time Read Receipt Tracking and UI Updates**
- Introduced live read receipt tracking in memory, with debounced/throttled updates to both the UI and the backend, and a new IntersectionObserver-based system to determine which messages are visible and thus read. This replaces the old scroll-based approach. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R22-R29) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1406-R1604) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1450-R1639) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R1661-R1663) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1501-R1699)
- Added logic to update the UI with avatars for each user indicating their last read message, and to handle incoming read status updates from other users via WebSocket. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R792-R794) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R840-R863) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1406-R1604)
- Ensured read status is saved before closing the chat, switching conversations, navigating away, and periodically every 30 seconds, to prevent lost updates. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R1977-R1978) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R2266-R2272) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R2299-R2310)

**Backend: WebSocket and API Enhancements for Read Receipts**
- Added a WebSocket handler for `read_status_update` messages, broadcasting read status changes to all other members of a conversation in real time, and verifying membership and data validity. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fR100-R104) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fR317-R374)
- Improved the API endpoint for updating read status to enforce monotonicity: the last read message ID can only move forward, never backward, preventing accidental "unreading" of messages.

**Code Quality and Data Consistency**
- Refactored member info retrieval in conversation APIs for clarity. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL946-L951) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL1085-L1090)
- Ensured that all read status operations are robust against race conditions and UI inconsistencies by centralizing and debouncing updates. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1406-R1604) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R2266-R2272)

These changes collectively provide a modern, reliable, and user-friendly read receipt experience in the chat system.

---

**Frontend: Live Read Receipts and UI**
- Implemented real-time, per-user read receipt tracking using IntersectionObserver, debounced/throttled UI and backend updates, and avatar indicators for each user's last read message. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R22-R29) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1406-R1604) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1450-R1639) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R1661-R1663) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6L1501-R1699)
- Handled incoming WebSocket read status updates and updated the UI accordingly. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R792-R794) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R840-R863)

**Frontend: Data Integrity and Persistence**
- Ensured read status is saved before closing the chat, switching conversations, navigating away, and periodically, to prevent data loss. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R1977-R1978) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R2266-R2272) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1d350f3c1d8d361f8bca5313041ead0fa624c6ea51a975c0d44f3d1362efcdb6R2299-R2310)

**Backend: WebSocket and API Enhancements**
- Added WebSocket support for broadcasting read status updates to all conversation members except the sender, with membership and data validation. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fR100-R104) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fR317-R374)
- Updated the API to enforce that read status can only move forward (monotonicity), preventing users from accidentally marking messages as unread.

**Backend: Code Quality**
- Refactored code for retrieving member info in conversation APIs for clarity and maintainability. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL946-L951) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL1085-L1090)
